set.body: The parity-gated side-256 directional comparison measured elementwise and broadcast cases at 0.119x-0.605x NumPy speed while view construction was near parity. Separate allocation, planning, dispatch, and loop costs; prioritize contiguous and broadcast paths. Acceptance: profiler evidence, unchanged semantic signatures, GC measurements, and a full default benchmark rerun on a quiet host.
set.title: Profile public elementwise access-pattern gaps
